personality_one_liner: Maximum contrast, massive touch targets, and unambiguous auditory-visual hierarchy for an inclusive reading experience.

spacing.rule: Massive touch targets and padding. No element smaller than 72pt height. Generous whitespace to avoid mis-taps.

dont's: Never use glassmorphism. It reduces contrast. Solid colors only.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: High contrast welcome screen with app name read out by screen reader.

states.loading: Solid black background, huge yellow app title, screen reader focus on title.

screens.layout: Centered logo and massive text 'Leggimi'. Pure black background.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Simple, large-button login via Email or Google.

states.error: High contrast error banner at top.

screens.layout: Vertical stack. Huge input fields with persistent white borders. Massive 72pt high buttons. Top to bottom: Title, Email Input, Password Input, Login Button, Google Login Button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main hub. Big 'Upload Book' action and list of recent books.

states.empty: Text 'Nessun libro caricato' and a huge upload button.
states.error: Text 'Errore caricamento' and a huge retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Menu' (offcanvas), Logo, 'Cerca' (Search). Below header: Massive fixed 'Carica Libri' CTA. Below CTA: Vertical list of uploaded books (each item minimum 72pt height, high contrast text). Bottom tabs (72pt+ height).

screens.name: Libreria
screens.layout: Header with title. Vertical list of books. Huge typography for titles. Explicit screen reader labels per row (e.g., 'Libro: [Titolo]'). Bottom tabs.

screens.name: Profilo
screens.layout: Header. Large avatar/initials. User info text. Big 'Esci' (Logout) button at the bottom.

screens.name: Impostazioni
screens.layout: Header. Stacked settings rows. Massive tap targets for sliders/steppers (TTS Speed, Pitch) with textual value readout. Voice selection dropdown.

screens.name: BookReader
screens.purpose: Read book content with prominent TTS controls.
screens.layout: Header with back button. Main area: Scrollable large text of the book. Sticky bottom section: Massive Play/Pause button, Next/Prev buttons, and TTS speed toggle. Controls must dominate the screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL ACCESSIBILITY: Every touch target MUST be at least 72pt in height/width. Do NOT use default component sizes.
CRITICAL ACCESSIBILITY: Implement pure black (#000000) background with bright yellow (#FFD600) or pure white (#FFFFFF) text. Never use low contrast grays.
CRITICAL ACCESSIBILITY: Add `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityRole`, and `accessible={true}` to EVERY interactive element in Italian.
TYPOGRAPHY: Minimum body size is 18pt, headings 24pt, buttons 32pt. Do not deviate. Ensure fonts scale correctly with system settings.
BOTTOM TABS: The bottom tab bar must be tall (at least 80pt) with large icons (32pt+) and bold labels.
TTS CONTROLS: In the BookReader, the Play/Pause button should dominate the screen's bottom half for easy reach by visually impaired users.
HAPTICS: Use explicit haptic feedback (`impactAsync('heavy')`) on ALL button presses to provide tactile confirmation.
NO GLASSMORPHISM: Do not use blur or glass effects. Solid high-contrast colors only.
